comments.content: The lambda captures `merging_nodes` by reference, so all scheduled tasks will use the last value from the loop. Use a default argument to bind the current value: `lambda merging_nodes=merging_nodes: self._merge_graph_nodes(graph, merging_nodes, change)`.

The `keywords` attribute is no longer merged. Previously both `keywords` and `source_id` were combined; now only `source_id` is updated, causing loss of keyword information. Please restore the merging of `keywords` as well.

The lambda captures `from_node` and `to_node` by reference, so all tasks will use the last values from the loop. Use default arguments to bind the current values: `lambda from_node=from_node, to_node=to_node: settings.docStoreConn.delete(...)`.
